fee_notes: Non-traditional structure: all commissions flow to Brightway first. Franchisee retains 80% of New Business commissions and 50% of Renewal Business commissions. Enhanced commission program allows up to 85% retention on New Business. Tech fees: $200/month per location + $209/month per active user + $75/month per inactive user + $90/user/month for Brightway Fusion (capped at $450/month). Advertising Fund not currently charged but may not exceed 3% of Brightway Sales Commissions if established.
raw_excerpt: Sales Commissions – New Business: 20% of Brightway Sales Commissions on New Business (you retain the remaining 80%). Sales Commissions – Renewal Business: 50% of Brightway Sales Commissions on Renewal Business (you retain the remaining 50%).
